title: anim.bake_order/1
description: data/anim/bake_order.json: the bake's order and what a slice may start (docs/animation/bake-pace.md; AnimData.bake_pending and _queue). `first` lists poses the fight asks for in the order the queue bakes them before the rest (the dear ones, then the cheap ones, each in the order a fight asks for them); `cost` is the microseconds each pose takes to bake on the reference PC, quiet, so a slice does not start a pose that would take it past its budget unless the slice has baked nothing. Only the order and the pace change: every pose is baked from the same sketch. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-reference to add in tools/lib/xref-fight.js (anim-bake-order-pose: every id in first and cost is a pose of poses.json or a wave's poses file).
